constants.name: BT_ORDER_EXPIRY_CANDLES
constants.unit: closed candles on entry_tf after the signal candle
constants.rationale: An unfilled limit order remains active for three later entry-timeframe candles; it expires at the close of the third candle.

constants.name: BT_DEFAULT_STOP_ATR
constants.rationale: Fallback stop distance from entry when a strategy has no structured stop rule.

constants.name: BT_DEFAULT_TARGET_R
constants.rationale: Fallback target distance when a strategy has no structured target rule; also the fixed target used by r_std2.

constants.name: BT_MAX_BARS_IN_TRADE
constants.unit: closed candles on entry_tf, including the fill candle
constants.rationale: Bounds the maximum holding period and makes time-stop and split-embargo behavior finite.
